playstyle: Aggressive Mishima rushdown. Overwhelm the opponent with fast pokes and quick transitions into Sentai (SEN) and Wrath of Raijin (WRA), backed by the wave dash and Electric Wind God Fist. Wavu warns her lows are committal (mostly launch punishable) and most moves are linear, so keep mids and transitions at the heart of your offence.
